name: Amharic Subword Tokenization Analysis
description: Empirical analysis of subword tokenization algorithms (BPE, WordPiece, Unigram) for Amharic and Ge'ez script. Benchmarks cross-lingual "Token Tax" against foundation LLMs (LLaMA-3, Mistral, GPT-4o), orthographic normalization, and vocabulary scaling on MasakhaNEWS
